title: Ringkasan tab shows title total card donut chart and category list
expected_result: Title "Ringkasan Bulan Ini"; "Total Pengeluaran" card; donut chart; per-category list

title: Monthly total equals sum since day 1 00:00
preconditions: Transactions across current and previous months
steps: 1. Compare displayed total to the sum of transactions since the 1st of the current month 00:00

title: Weekly view starts from Monday and includes the current Sunday
steps:
1. Click "Mingguan"
2. Check totals against transactions since Monday 00:00 of the current week
expected_result: Title "Ringkasan Minggu Ini"; button now reads "Bulanan"; total = since Monday 00:00 this week (Sunday still counted as part of the same week)

title: Per-category rows sorted descending with proportion bar
expected_result: Only categories with transactions shown; sorted largest amount first; each row shows icon, name, amount, and a bar = amount divided by total

title: Donut chart shows fixed per-category colors and tooltip hidden with no data
preconditions: Transactions across multiple categories; also test with none
steps:
1. View the donut chart with data
2. Hover a slice
3. Remove all transactions and view again
expected_result: One slice per category, consistent color per category, tooltip shows the Rupiah amount; chart hidden when there is no data

title: Empty state text for monthly and weekly views
preconditions: No transactions in the current period
steps:
1. View Ringkasan with no transactions this month
2. Switch to Mingguan with none this week
expected_result: Total "Rp 0"; text "Belum ada riwayat transaksi." (weekly: "Belum ada riwayat transaksi minggu ini.")

title: Summary updates live when data changes
steps: 1. Add edit or delete a transaction in the current period

title: Transactions from prior months are excluded
preconditions: Transactions exist in the current and a previous month
steps: 1. View the current month's total and category breakdown
expected_result: Previous month's transactions are not counted

title: Ringkasan opens without permission-denied errors and shows real totals
preconditions: Signed in with existing transactions this month; browser DevTools console open
steps:
1. Open the Ringkasan tab
2. Check the console
3. Compare totals to the transactions
expected_result: No "permission-denied" error in the console; total and categories match real data, not a wrong Rp 0

title: Add / edit / delete / undo keeps category breakdown, donut and total consistent
preconditions: Ringkasan tab reachable; some transactions this month
steps:
1. Add a transaction
2. Edit its amount and category
3. Undo a fresh one from the save toast
4. Delete another from Riwayat
5. After each step open Ringkasan
6. Look for any "rebuild"/manual repair control
expected_result: After every step total, donut and per-category rows all agree with each other (sum of category rows = total); no button or manual step to rebuild the summary exists

title: Inconsistent day is repaired automatically in the background when Ringkasan opens
preconditions: A day whose category breakdown does not match its total (legacy data; needs seeded/old data on emulator or a legacy account)
steps:
1. Open the Ringkasan tab
2. Wait a moment without any action
3. Compare breakdown/total with Riwayat
4. Repeat while offline
expected_result: The inconsistent day is fixed automatically (only that day), display becomes correct without user action or reload; no toast or dialog; nothing is repaired while offline

title: Offline create/edit/delete then online keeps Riwayat and Ringkasan in agreement
preconditions: Direct form usable offline; known totals
steps:
1. Go offline
2. Create, edit and delete transactions via the direct form / Riwayat
3. Go back online and wait for sync
4. Compare the Ringkasan total with the sum of transactions in Riwayat
expected_result: Transactions and daily summary are saved together; final Ringkasan numbers equal the Riwayat sum, no difference left over
